title: Halco Racing
description: High-performance digital presence and modernization for an automotive brand.
problem: A performance-focused automotive brand needed a storefront that kept its catalogue fast and consistent across every device, without a redesign cycle stalling the next parts drop.
built: Rebuilt the public-facing site on a managed platform with a compressed image pipeline, and wired direct WhatsApp enquiry from product pages.

title: Zero Hour Event
description: Dynamic event management platform bringing seamless booking and marketing to life.
problem: A Dhaka event and logistics provider was taking enquiries by hand across calls and messages, with no single place for a client to see packages or reserve a date.
built: Built the public site with package browsing, enquiry capture, and campaign tracking running end to end from one platform.

title: ServedCo
description: Streamlined service delivery architecture and user experience overhaul.
problem: Years of accumulated technical debt had left the service delivery path slow to change and hard to reason about during peak booking periods.
built: Resolved the accumulated technical debt across the service delivery path, and consolidated enquiry capture onto a single verified contact channel.

title: Health Steward
description: Collaborative development to ensure HIPAA-compliant digital pathways for health providers.
problem: A health provider needed digital pathways that route patient-facing information correctly, with compliance treated as a build requirement rather than a review stage.
built: Delivered compliant digital pathways for health providers, with form handling and analytics vetted for regulated data.

title: Woztell
description: Integrated conversational AI logic for expansive WhatsApp marketing.
problem: A conversational marketing platform needed its WhatsApp flows to hold up as campaign volume grew, without manual handling becoming the bottleneck.
built: Implemented the conversational AI logic behind the WhatsApp marketing flows, with payment and analytics integrations left instrumented.

title: Sanuker
description: Partnered build for robust chatbot architecture across diverse messaging platforms.
problem: An APAC messaging provider needed its chatbot architecture to stay reliable across several messaging platforms at once, each with its own delivery rules.
built: Built the chatbot architecture spanning multiple messaging platforms, keeping commerce and analytics integrations intact.
